item.tib: dregs pa spyi yi khrom bskul
item.coloph: de ltar dregs pa khrom bskul zhes bya ba ldang gi rigs kyi rnam ((rnal) 'byor ha ra wer zha'i (zhis) sbyar ba dge'o// mi dred ma dang dkar mo tshe sgrab pom ra gcan lha gshin rje nyi pang sad shel khrab can dang bdun/ khyung btsun ku su lu pas sbyar ba nyes 'gal skyabs yul gnyen la bshags//
